business_summary: Frontier Services Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides security, insurance, aviation, logistics, and infrastructure-related services in China, Hong Kong, Kenya, Nigeria, Laos, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and internationally. The company offers protective services, including threat and risk assessments, executive/close protection, safety implementation, strategy and policy development, and physical and technical, IT, and aviation security, as well as specialized training services; and finance, liability, property, and personnel insurance programs, as well as special insurance solutions, such as medical and emergency evacuation, repatriation, kidnap and ransom response, and crisis management. It also provides aviation services; engineering project logistics services and transportation of valuables; and infrastructure solutions comprising project planning, business consulting, investment and financing, engineering design, project implementation and operation, and support services. In addition, the company engages in aircraft holding; consultancy services; and investment management. It serves the oil and gas, mining, finance, energy, and infrastructure industries, as well as international organizations. The company was formerly known as DVN (Holdings) Limited and changed its name to Frontier Services Group Limited in March 2014. Frontier Services Group Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: Frontier Services Group Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국, 홍콩, 케냐, 나이지리아, 라오스, 콩고 민주 공화국 및 국제적으로 보안, 보험, 항공, 물류 및 인프라 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 위협 및 위험 평가, 경영진/밀접 보호, 안전 구현, 전략 및 정책 개발, 물리 및 기술, IT, 항공 보안을 포함한 보호 서비스와 전문 교육 서비스를 제공합니다. 금융, 책임, 재산 및 인사 보험 프로그램은 물론 의료 및 응급 대피, 송환, 납치 및 몸값 대응, 위기 관리와 같은 특수 보험 솔루션도 포함됩니다. 또한 항공 서비스도 제공합니다. 엔지니어링 프로젝트 물류 서비스 및 귀중품 운송; 프로젝트 계획, 비즈니스 컨설팅, 투자 및 자금 조달, 엔지니어링 설계, 프로젝트 구현 및 운영, 지원 서비스로 구성된 인프라 솔루션입니다. 또한 회사는 항공기 보유에도 종사하고 있습니다. 컨설팅 서비스; 및 투자 관리. 석유 및 가스, 광업, 금융, 에너지 및 인프라 산업에 서비스를 제공합니다.
